title: Nadree backend source-defined error code index
provenance: Static source inspection only. No production logs, database, Redis, environment files, credentials, AWS or external services were read.

field_definitions.defined_http_statuses: Literal/manual-resolved Problem and common-handler status definitions. Internal/inactive sources retain their numeric definition here, but that is not an assertion of HTTP reachability.
field_definitions.outcome_metadata_http_statuses: HTTP success responses that intentionally carry this errorCode as stored business outcome metadata. Kept separate from exception HTTP statuses.
field_definitions.scope: Most externally relevant occurrence class; inspect each source.scope for mixed use.
field_definitions.scopes: HTTP=registered handler or common handler; conditional=shared helper/caller-dependent; internal=worker/CLI/persisted/log diagnostic; inactive=unregistered feature; needs_review=dynamic or unproven classification.
field_definitions.summary_ko: Curated brief Korean meaning when reviewed; null means no translation was supplied rather than a guessed meaning.
field_definitions.condition_assignments: Correlated conditional branches; identical predicates, including normalized not, must agree. Impossible cross products are discarded.

unresolved_dynamic_sources.reason: Intentional dynamic replay of stored http_status/error_code. reject() persists the originating non-transient Problem; no finite new code list is defined here. Never form a Cartesian product of all statuses and codes.

special_response_patterns.note: A stored REJECTED result is returned as status=success in HTTP 200; the originating rejection code is metadata.
Closing an unaccepted key finalizes its result without creating a booking. A later POST replays stored rejection status/code.
Problems with status >=500 and RESOURCE_BUSY/RATE_LIMITED remain UNKNOWN/transient; other originating Problems can be persisted and replayed.
Catches shared guard Problems and returns error.code as action eligibility metadata, not errorCode.
Eligibility metadata; do not promote every reason string to a new HTTP errorCode definition.
Eligibility metadata in successful responses; same literal can separately have an HTTP exception definition.
Webhook responses contain a boolean status, not the standard errorCode envelope; caught provider/domain errors may be persisted internally.
Successful legacy administrator QR response uses status=true and errorCode=null; null is not an error code.
Successful legacy action envelope uses status=true and errorCode=null; null is not an error code.
Default framework 404/405 responses are not custom errorCode definitions. This index does not invent NOT_FOUND/METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED codes.

external_namespaces_separate.note: Provider name/error/debug-ID values are provider diagnostics; do not confuse raw invalid_client or provider issue codes with backend Problem codes. No provider request was made.
Firebase/FCM SDK delivery error names are transport results, not this API errorCode namespace. Not enumerated here.
Callable HttpsError codes belong to Firebase callable protocol. This artifact indexes app/*.py only; callable definitions are not merged or audited here.
